name: Qbittorrent
description: Aplikasi di-deploy dari berkas Docker Compose YAML (linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest)
compose_yaml:
version: '3.8'
services:
  qbittorrent:
    image: linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    container_name: qbittorrent
    ports:
      - "8085:8080"
    volumes:
      - /DATA/apps/qbittorrent/config:/config
